summary: Validated iter-83 features (multilingual emails infra, AI cost counter, CRM multilingual UI) end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 tests pass including language persistence via PUT /api/auth/language (es persists via GET /auth/me; invalid 'zz' normalizes to 'fr'), register-with-lang, GET/PUT /api/admin/ai-model (quality/speed/cost ints returned, haiku persists, invalid tier -> 400), GET /api/admin/ai-usage shape, real AI call via POST /api/estimation/analyse increments total_calls and by_feature['smart_project'] counter, and GET /api/documents/{id}/pdf returns 200 application/pdf. Frontend: Admin 'IA' tab renders 3 model cards (opus/sonnet/haiku) with speed/cost/quality bars, active tier highlighted (sonnet), usage section shows 'Total 2 appels', clicking haiku then sonnet updates it. CRM multilingual UI works on /clients ('Vos clients'/'Your clients'/'Tus clientes'), /devis-editeur ('Éditeur de devis'/'Editor — quote'/'Editor de presupuesto'), /factures ('Mes factures'/'My invoices'/'Mis facturas') with NO raw 'crm.*' or i18n key leaks in any language. Language choice persists across navigation (after set to 'es' on /factures, /admin lang-toggle value still 'es').

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be child of <option>'. Caused by devtools/instrumentation wrapping the option text in a span (x-ve-dynamic). Not blocking but produces a hydration error in dev. Consider ensuring option children are plain strings only.
Admin dashboard chrome (Administration, tab names, KPI labels) stays in French when lang=en/es. Out-of-scope per iter-83 (only CRM pages targeted) but flagging for consistency.

action_items: Optional: fix QuoteEditor <option> children being wrapped by span (hydration warning).
Optional: extend i18n coverage to /admin chrome labels for full multilingual UX.
critical_code_review_comments: AI usage log increments correctly via _log_usage() in engines/ai.py and admin route aggregates properly.
PUT /api/auth/language uses norm_lang() with FR fallback — good, invalid inputs normalized safely.
GET /api/admin/ai-model exposes quality/speed/cost integers per option — frontend uses them for bars correctly.
PDF endpoint responds 200 with application/pdf for existing documents (label localization not visually verifiable but body length >500 bytes).
test_iter83 file added following pytest conventions with class-scoped fixtures for admin/pro auth.
